segments.name: Children's Book Publishing and Distribution
segments.description: Publishes and distributes children's print, digital and audio books in the United States through school-based book fairs, book clubs and the trade channel.
segments.evidence: This segment comprises the Company's Children's Book Group, which includes the Book Fairs, Book Clubs, and Trade Publishing divisions.

segments.name: Education
segments.evidence: a leading provider of print and digital instructional materials for grades pre-kindergarten ("pre-K") to grade 12

segments.name: Entertainment
segments.evidence: The Entertainment segment includes the operations of 9 Story Media Group Inc. as acquired on June 20, 2024, including its studios in Canada, Ireland and Indonesia ("9 Story"), and Scholastic Entertainment Inc. ("SEI").

segments.name: International
segments.description: Operates the Company's children's book publishing, book clubs, book fairs, trade and educational businesses outside the United States, including export sales.
segments.evidence: Scholastic has operations in the United States and throughout the world including Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Asia and, through its export business, sells products in approximately 145 international locations.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue by selling children's books, educational materials and media to schools, families, teachers, bookstores, online retailers and mass merchandisers through its proprietary school channels, trade channel and international operations.
revenueModel.evidence: It distributes its products and services through these channels, retail stores and the internet, as well as directly to schools and libraries.
